title: Former Google DeepMind Researchers ... To Launch Udio (Udio, via PR Newswire)
notes: Udio official launch PR (2024-04-10). Udio = self-made AI music model by former Google DeepMind researchers. Founders: David Ding, Conor Durkan, Charlie Nash, Yaroslav Ganin, Andrew Sanchez. Backed by a16z + will.i.am, Common, Kevin Wall, Tay Keith, UnitedMasters (Steve Stoute), Mike Krieger, Oriol Vinyals. CEO: PR names David Ding; later sources (ITU/LinkedIn/MBW 2026) name Andrew Sanchez — caveat. Not established as the model for any Q1 AI-hip-hop artist.
